news.text: Upgraded HOI-BFM official standard to hoi-bfm-official-2026-11-24 (position_score = min(pos_rel_score, pos_world_score) with World 3D 0.20–1.00 m cap) across all 8 policies × 6 Sim2Real protocols, and replaced Ghost Replays with 3 five-policy 2×3 side-by-side comparison videos.
Published full 8-policy × 6-protocol Sim2Real evaluation matrix (Nominal → P0 → Input DR → Object Physics DR → Object Pose DR → Full DR), strictly isolated by protocol_sha256.

Adopted hoi-bfm-official-2026-11-23 (4–12 Hz pelvic angular jitter gate J ≤ 0.25 rad/s + multiplicative stability discount α=0.20) and onboarded partymimic_hoi_tq3e5_20261123 & partymimic_hoi_pushL_20261123.
Launched BFM BenchMark | Leaderboard 0.1 unifying BFM (Protocol v2) and HOI-BFM evaluation tracks.
Added hsw_amp_a_s43_raw and hsw_scalebfm_oa_s42_raw (raw_trajectory_v1 in-graph reference ONNX) and completed full 6-policy closed-loop evaluation on the 218-clip clean subset.
Adopted hoi-bfm-official-2026-11-11: removed object pose error from hard success gates and switched contact_recall to real MuJoCo hand-object collision signals.
Onboarded zl_v92_20261108 (recurrent depth + proprio student) and hsw_hoi_20261108 (RGB + proprio student).
Onboarded zl_v63_prop_20261105 (proprioceptive baseline) and clf_hoi_20261104 (cached-depth final student, checkpoint 2026-11-04).
